page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running head and page number at the top. Heading "VERSVS XVI." with an italic verse passage below it. One marginal note in the right margin beside "Qui adeò".

main_text.p: obfcurare conantur: tamen trifte eft, fi quis illorum κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς[?] nobis falfa obtrudedo & fophiftice pingendo prodefse cogatur. Vt hac ætate homines illi eruditi & exercitati, qui Iefu nomen fuæ focietati tribuunt, fophiftica fua faciunt, ut folidæ & feueriori Theologiæ nobis incumbedum effe, re ipfa experiamur. Faxit Chriftus Iefus, ut dictis & factis, totaque uita noftra, feruiamus inftaurationi tum noftræ, tum etiam proximorum noftrorum, in fide & conuerfatione fancta, & feruiente diuini nominis fanctifica-tioni.
main_text.head: VERSVS XVI.

p.i: Saturatus es (Regum) ignominia præ gloria: bibes tu quoq;, & nudaberis: vertet enim se super te calix dextera Iehoua, & vomitus ignominiosus (decidet) super gloriam tuam.

main_text.p: Qui adeò sunt ebrij voluptatibus & magnitudine rerum gestarum & succef-suum, ut illiberalem voluptatem perci-piant ex aliena ignominia, calamitate & ruina: ij profecto digni sunt, qui in eorū-dem malorū gurgites tandem prolaban-tur,a. ri in[?]

page.notes: Greek word after "illorum" is uncertain (κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς assumed, letters not clear). Marginal note at right beside "Qui adeò" is very small and uncertain: read as "a." and "rī in", doubtful. "lehoua" printed with a capital that resembles l; read as Iehoua. Hyphenated word "succef-/suum" and "perci-/piant" kept as printed at line ends. No catchword or signature visible.
